name: Palmaria nel Cuore [Italian]
content: Note: the following entry is a stub. You can help Participedia by adding to it.Problems and PurposeFor the drafting of the intervention scenarios and the program for the overall enhancement of the Island of Palmaria Island (Municipality of Porto Venere, La Spezia) on 11/09/2017 the task was entrusted for the design and construction of a participatory course: “Palmaria nel Cuore”. At the moment the path is still in progress; some narrative excursions were carried out on the island (17/10/2017) and two focus groups (18/10/2017).Background History and ContextOrganizing, Supporting, and Funding EntitiesParticipant Recruitment and SelectionMethods and Tools UsedWhat Went On: Process, Interaction, and ParticipationInfluence, Outcomes, and EffectsAnalysis and Lessons LearnedSee AlsoReferencesExternal LinksPalmaria in the heart> http://www.palmarianelcuore.it/it/home (ril. 2/2/2018).Notes
